# langchain-vend

LangChain tools that call the Vend pay-per-call API (https://paypercall.dev) and
settle each call in Nano (XNO) via x402 (https://x402.org) — the machine-payment
protocol that answers HTTP 402. No signup, no API keys, no subscriptions: you pay
per call, in Nano, only when the server answers.

## Install

```
pip install "langchain-vend[live] @ git+https://github.com/dhyabi2/langchain-vend.git"
```

## Tools

| Tool | Endpoint | Price (XNO) |
|---|---|---|
| VendWebSearch | search.paypercall.dev/api/v1/web-search | 0.0001 |
| VendExtract | extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/extract | 0.0001 |
| VendGeoIP | geoip.paypercall.dev/api/v1/geoip | 0.0001 |

Each is a `langchain_core.tools.BaseTool`, so it works in any LangChain or
LangGraph agent, and — through Pydantic AI's `tool_from_langchain` /
`LangChainToolset` bridge — in Pydantic AI agents too.

## Documents

- README: https://github.com/dhyabi2/langchain-vend
- Vend docs and live x402 manifest: https://extract.paypercall.dev/

## Honest limits

- Dry-run is safe and default: with no wallet the tool returns the live quote
  (price, network, pay_to) and spends nothing.
- Live payment needs the optional `[live]` extra (`nano_pay`) and a Nano wallet
  holding XNO; the quoted price is 0.0001 XNO per call to the swarm treasury.
